name: Kentucky Waterways Alliance Watershed Seed Grants
summary: Seed grants for organisations in Kentucky running projects that tackle nonpoint source pollution to protect and restore rivers, streams and watersheds, aiming to fund at least one project in each major river basin.
reporting: A mid-project report and a final report, each with supporting documents.

status.quote: 11/4/26 - Grant applications due to laura@kwalliance.org by 11:59pm

deadline.quote: 11/4/26 - Grant applications due to laura@kwalliance.org by 11:59pm

geography.quote: This initiative offers seed funding to support organizations committed to protecting and restoring Kentucky's rivers, streams, and watersheds.

access.quote: CLICK HERE FOR COMPLETE GRANT GUIDELINES & DEADLINES CLICK HERE FOR APPLICATION

window.quote: Completed grant applications are due by November 4, 2026.

amount.quote: Grants fund up to $4,500 per project.

effort.quote: Completed grant applications are due by November 4, 2026.

eligibility.quote: Projects must address nonpoint source pollution (NPS) which is pollution that cannot be directly attributed to a distinct source.
profit businesses are not eligible for KWA grant funds at this time.

after_award.quote: 50% of funds will be distributed upon project award agreement, 25% at mid-project report with supporting documentation submission and approval, and 25% upon project completion and final report and supporting documentation submission and approval.
